name: Perceptive Lockplate
description: Counts paces and cadence with the platoon so every musket speaks on the same beat.

name: Silt Barrelband
description: Shuffles a half pace along the rank until the shoulder touches its neighbour and the line is true.

name: Facetsalvo
description: Fires level from the front rank at a measured pace, never hurrying the reload for the next shot.

name: Gustaim
description: Lays the barrel through the space between two front-rank men and fires past their ears.

name: Discerning Touchpan
description: Loads on one knee beneath the guns of the standing rank, with the butt grounded to save time.

name: Ponderous Aim
description: Links the qi of one file's men by drumbeat so their shots leave the barrels with matching force.

name: Intentsmoke
description: Holds the loaded rank at the aim with qi in the arms until the word, then releases every shot at once.

name: Surging Prime
description: Surges two paces toward the centre of the rank on a pulse of qi to close a gap torn by enemy shot.

name: Scorching Mayhem Smoke
description: Gathers the rank's drawn qi along the barrels for a count, then releases a wide sheet of shot across the whole front.

name: Serpent Cloak
description: Advances in step with qi spread across the front of the line like a woven screen to blunt return fire.

name: Vital Bayonetlug
description: Rolls a film of qi around the ball as the ramrod seats it, so the load sits snug and true.

name: Flintcock Elixir
description: Matches one breath to the weight of the powder charge, so the field and the burn rise together.

name: Verity Wheellock
description: Extends the living field to the mark and feels its distance before the eye has finished the sight.

name: Tearing Stockbutt
description: Lets the field hold the barrel as if clamped, and fires a flat shot with no trace of tremor.

name: Blaze Pan
description: Spins a coil of qi round the ball in the bore so it holds its line to the end of the musket's reach.

name: Rousing Ramrod
description: Sweeps a burst of qi down the bore after the shot to loosen fouling before the next load.

name: Tempered Salvo
description: Drives the ball with a short hard pulse of qi at close range so it pierces a light shield.

name: Aimbarrage
description: Wraps the ball in dense qi to punch through plate and shield that would stop an ordinary musket ball.

name: Facetload
description: Keeps the qi field stretched to the mark to guide the ball through the last stretch of its flight.

name: Torrent Load
description: Shifts the lead foot a hand's breadth to turn the body edge-on while the point stays on the line.

name: Enduring Wheellock
description: Beats the enemy point aside and returns the bayonet to the guard in a single short circle.

name: Gust Load
description: Pushes the butt straight into the belly from the hip, doubling the man over the stock.

name: Rumblesalvo
description: Shoves an enemy musket sideways with the open palm until its bayonet points at the next man.

name: Manacling Stockbutt
description: Traps an enemy weapon between barrel and bayonet and pries it free with qi-strong wrists.

name: Rumbleramrod
description: Feints a thrust at the face and snaps the butt up under the chin as the guard rises.

name: Harrowing Barrelband
description: Drives the bayonet through a guard on a full surge of meridian qi, lifting the target off his feet.

name: Murkfuze
description: Catches a heavy cut at the barrel's balance point, then rolls the parry into a thrust at the exposed throat.

name: Fuzeelixir
description: Reads the distance to the mark from the way the qi field thins at its far edge.

name: Facetpan
description: Closes the horn and pouch with a pulse of qi so no damp reaches the charge on a long wait.

name: Vitalpan
description: Pours a full measure from the horn for the longest reach, the thumb stopping the flow at the mark.

name: Touchpan Barrage
description: Tips the barrel upward to drop a ball over a low wall at the very edge of the reach.

name: Flintcock Linctus
description: Keeps a slow even breath through a long approach to the firing place, arriving with a steady hand.

name: Bayonetlug Remedy
description: Loads at half pace while shot strikes the ground nearby, putting accuracy of the next ball before speed.

name: Loadassault
description: Pushes a last pulse of qi behind the ball as it clears the muzzle, so it carries a little farther.

name: Pan Elixir
description: Opens the field forward to part the smoke of one's own shot so the mark stays in view.

name: Harrowing Powder
description: Lifts the ball on a thin cushion of qi at the end of its arc, trimming the drop.

name: Hour Ramrod
description: Lands a ball in front of a distant officer's boots to freeze the group around him in place.

name: Hoarfrost Salvo
description: Gathers the whole field behind one ball over a long count and fires it at the last edge of the reach.

name: Silt Smoke
description: Steps off with the left foot in the front rank and the right foot in the rear, keeping the two ranks in time.

name: Vigorous Lockplate
description: Passes the empty piece to a loader at one's side and takes a loaded one without breaking the aim.

name: Furrowing Aim
description: Fires level along the front track, then drops to the knee at once to make room for the rear track.

name: Rumblepowder
description: Fires from the standing rear track across the kneeling front man's shoulder in the moment he clears the line.

name: Gust Stockbutt
description: Crosses bayonets with the partner at one's shoulder so a thrust meets two points instead of one.

name: Hoarfrost Lockplate
description: Locks one shoulder to the partner's and braces both stances against a charge that tries to split the pair.

name: Fuzetorment
description: Fires track against track in turn, qi lending each shooter a short rest while the other loads.

name: Aimtorment
description: Sends a shared pulse of qi from the front man to the rear man so both shots leave with equal force.

name: Thornfuze
description: Crosses two barrels overhead with a partner and lets qi pass between them to take a heavy blow.

name: Siltpowder
description: Swaps places with the partner behind in two quick steps, so a fresh man faces the foe.

name: Daybreak Prime
description: Crosses the fire of two ranks at an angle on one drawn qi count, so their shots meet over the foe.

name: Doctrine Pan
description: Chains a front-rank shot, a handoff and a rear-rank shot into one unbroken answer among paired shooters.

name: Chime Serpent
description: Drops the gaze from above onto the mark in one swift stoop, as a hawk fixes its prey.

name: Remnant Wheellock
description: Compares the mark against the open sky and the horizon to judge how far away it stands.

name: Chimesmoke
description: Hangs motionless on the aim like a hawk on the air, then lets the ball fly without a flicker.

name: Nova Powder
description: Fires from a high perch on a roof or branch, resting the barrel on the edge for support.

name: Nursing Touchpan
description: Fixes one man in a crowd with the field and follows him by feel even when he drops from sight.

name: Tempered Barrelband
description: Fires steeply downward from a height, qi hardening the ball so it drives through a helm.

name: Equipoise Ramrod
description: Loads in three sharp beats of the hands, like wings snapping open, while the eye never leaves the mark.

name: Raging Powder
description: Sends a single field-guided ball from a high vantage onto a chosen man far below.

name: Hour Salvo
description: Sweeps the barrel slowly over a ridge so every head showing along it must duck and stay down.

name: Soaring Aim
description: Forms the line along the high rim of a hollow so each man sees clear down its slope.

name: Nursing Flintcock
description: Loads in one smooth continuous run of motions, each step flowing into the next without a stop.

name: Gust Serpent
description: Holds the musket and pouch high over the waterline while wading so the powder stays dry.

name: Nova Smoke
description: Lies on a riverbank with the fore-end rested on a root and fires along the water.

name: Waning Bayonetlug
description: Sights on the darker shapes in morning mist rising off the water, ignoring the pale glare.

name: Hour Flintcock
description: Fires from the water's edge with the stance planted against the current, qi holding every man in place.

name: Hardened Barrelband
description: Seals the pan and pouch with a skin of qi against rain and spray for as long as it is held.

name: Silt Stockbutt
description: Turns on one foot in a tight circle, like a water eddy, to face a flank attack without losing the line.

name: Slagload
description: Draws the shots of the rim toward the basin's centre on a long qi count, so every ball falls on the same ground.

name: Ponderous Load
description: Pours fire onto the far bank while the line wades across, qi sustaining the guns through the long cover.

name: Remnant Lockplate
description: Learns the breath-count that separates two shots by exactly one heartbeat and keeps the pair even.

name: Discerning Bayonetlug
description: Loads two muskets in one routine, alternating powder, ball and rod so each piece is ready in turn.

name: Rumble Prime
description: Fires the first piece clean and drops it at the hip without ever lowering the eye.

name: Chime Ramrod
description: Raises the second musket into the same sight picture and fires a heartbeat after the first.

name: Fortifying Serpent
description: Swaps hands from one piece to the other in a blur, qi quickening the grip at each handoff.

name: Pan Assault
description: Joins the qi of the two pieces so that the pair of balls travel with the same drive.

name: Splitting Salvo
description: Fires two muskets a heartbeat apart so the second ball follows the first through the same breach in armour.

name: Funneling Load
description: Fires one piece, ducks behind cover to reload it and rises to fire the second in one rhythm.
